title: Micro debrief cheat-sheet: 1:1 prep + follow-ups
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with report (30m) — quick debrief + action alignment
Date: 2027-05-11 10:00am local
Attendee: Ellis Zhou (manager) + direct report
Context: sprint wrap week — want lightweight sync: unblock, calibrate priorities, career pulse, and 2 quick follow-ups. Keep under 30m.

Goals for this 1:1 (what I want to get out of it):
- Surface any hidden blockers that could derail canary next week (INF-2891).
- Confirm who owns rollback/monitoring checklist for the new prefetch KV cache experiment.
- Quick career touch: where are they on IC ladder goals? pick 1 small stretch project for next 6 weeks.
- Agree on 3 concrete action items and deadlines.

Agenda (time boxed):
1) 3m — personal check-in (energy, anything urgent)
2) 8m — wins / ship checklist (what shipped this sprint, risks)
3) 10m — blockers + decisions needed (prioritize)
4) 6m — career/next steps + feedback
5) 3m — recap + actions / calendar sync

Quick update prompts to ask them (short-hand):
- Ship: which PRs still blocked? (PR #412 merging blocker: flaky test + infra perms)
- Metrics: latency p95 last 48h? any spike after rollback? (check dashboards)
- Oncall noise: did SRE still see the same error spike after hotfix?
- Dependency: do we need another infra slot for dedicated GPU for canary throughput test?

Notes / things to listen for (things I'll follow up on if they say yes):
- "I can't repro locally" => ask for a minimal repro + environment details, set target by EOD.
- "Blocked by infra" => escalate to Samir (infra) with a short runbook to unblock.
- "Too much context switching" => consider re-prioritizing tasks next sprint, remove 1 low-impact task.

Recent accomplishments (to highlight quickly):
- Finished local prefetch prototype that reduces cold-start token time by ~18% (perf run on small dataset).
- Migration of continuous-batching metrics to per-model dashboards (makes sprints easier).

Open blockers I expect to hear about (prepped):
- INF-2891: canary churn — flaky upstream test referencing old KV schema (owner: @report). Need a short-term shim or test skip.
- Dedicated capacity allocation: team requested 1 extra GPU slot for throughput tests; budget ok? ask finance? (cc finance)
- SLO regression: p99 tail for small requests ticked up 12% after recent kernel bump. Is there a repro?

Decisions we might need to make in the meeting:
- Accept test skip for canary vs. pause rollout (risk tradeoffs).
- Approve short-term dedicated slot for next 48h throughput run.
- Pick the stretch project: (a) benchmark-driven KV prefetch hardening, (b) reduce cold-start time across models, (c) mentor rotating oncall junior.

Career & growth quick script (6 min):
- Where do you want to make the biggest jump in next 6 months? technical depth vs product influence?
- One concrete small project (4–6 weeks) that pushes you: propose it now; I'll commit to shielding ~20% time.
- Ask: do you want regular feedback cadence? (biweekly quick check-ins possible)

Feedback I plan to give (concise):
- Positive: solid shipping velocity, good clarity on PR descriptions and test cases.
- Area: push earlier for help when blocked on infra — escalate sooner to avoid last-minute rush.

Action items template (we'll capture live here):
- Action 1: Fix flaky test in INF-2891 (owner: report) — due: 2027-05-12 EOD. If blocked, drop a note in #infra-ops and ping Samir.
- Action 2: Schedule 2-hour dedicated throughput run on Friday; Ellis to confirm slot with infra (owner: Ellis) — due: 2027-05-13 morning.
- Action 3: Draft 4-week stretch plan for KV prefetch hardening; include 2 measurable milestones (owner: report) — due: 2027-05-18.
- Bonus: Add a short blameless postmortem template for canary failures to Confluence (owner: Maya) — due: 2027-05-20.

Notes to self (manager prep):
- Bring data: p95/p99 dashboards link open during call.
- Have PR #412 ready to reference (preview diff).
- Keep tone: pragmatic + supportive — goal is unblock not micromanage.
- If they pick mentor option, propose pairing slot for 1:1 on mentoring first week.

Follow-up communication plan after 1:1:
- Send short summary email/snippet in DM with 3 bullets (wins, 3 actions with owners/dates).
- Update INF-2891 ticket with test-fix progress and close when merged.
- Create calendar block for throughput run and invite infra lead + QA.

Templates / quick copy (to paste into DM after meeting):
- "Thanks for sync — quick recap:\n  • Wins: [X]\n  • Actions: 1) INF-2891 test fix — @you — due 2027-05-12; 2) throughput run — @Ellis — 2027-05-13; 3) stretch plan — @you — 2027-05-18\n  • Ping me if stuck on infra — I'll escalate."

Longer-term items to track (bucket for next sprint planning):
- Improve canary test coverage for KV schema migrations (owner: eng-platform).
- Run a small experiment on prefetch cache eviction policy — see perf sketch in GH PR notes.
- Recruit one SWE for infra-hardening (raise in hiring sync).

Loose brainstorm fragments (these are rough):
- Lighthouse metric: combine p95 latency + error-rate to make a single signal for canary health. Explore weighting.
- Canary rollback recipe: auto rollback if (error_rate > 0.5% && p95 > baseline*1.15) for >5min. Create small runbook.

End-of-meeting checklist (what I'll confirm live):
- Are the action owners clear? (if not, assign explicitly)
- Do we have dates in calendar? set them now.
- Any blocking dependencies (infra/QA/legal)? call them out now.

Misc scratch (for future):
- Check slack thread ts:1654012345 for infra notes before meeting.
- If person seems burned out, propose a 2-week reduced scope plan.

-- Ellis
